groups.saying_opens: أليس قد علمت أن جبريل نزل فصلى
أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يصلي العصر

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads: the Jibril prayer-times saying (Urwa → Bashir → his father) and Aisha's saying (Urwa → Aisha); both are stored, each labelled
«قال عروة كذلك كان بشير ... يحدث عن أبيه» is Urwa answering Umar, so Urwa is a link in his own place; «أبيه» is a relation, not completed
Umar's story is the scene of Ibn Shihab's report, not a link; the Prophet is the end
